research_question: Can completed Bybit BTCUSDT event-time shocks reveal economically large, still-unincorporated SOLUSDT or XRPUSDT responses after explicit latency and 12/18/24bp round-trip costs?
economic_mechanism: BTC is the dominant price-discovery leader; a less liquid follower can incorporate common information with a short delay.

A trade is considered only when completed BTC price and aggressive flow agree, BTC activity is abnormal, the follower has incorporated less than its prior-only beta-implied response and the residual gap itself is large enough to clear costs.
SOL and XRP are tested separately and may later compete for the single global account slot; BTC-to-ETH evidence is not reused as a performance prior.

markets.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

official_source.integrity: Every downloaded gzip is hashed before any feature or strategy computation; HTTP, gzip, schema, monotonic-time and UTC-day coverage failures are explicit source failures.

information_contract.decision: Only after a complete BTC and contemporaneous follower 1/2/5-second window.
information_contract.feature_mark: Causal last public-trade price carried for at most 2000ms; no interpolation across a stale state.
information_contract.rolling_features: Beta, volatility and activity baselines end strictly before shock start.
information_contract.entry_and_exit: Any later trading replay must use the first actual follower trade after the applicable decision plus latency.

feature_formula.beta: OLS cov(BTC_1s,follower_1s)/var(BTC_1s) on 1800 prior seconds; at least 1200 finite pairs and 100 nonzero BTC returns; clip to [0.1,3.0].
feature_formula.shock_scale: sqrt(H/900 * sum of squared finite BTC one-second returns over 900 prior seconds); at least 600 finite and 60 nonzero returns.
feature_formula.activity_baseline: Median of prior positive H-second BTC quote-notional windows ending at one-second boundaries during the 900 seconds before shock start; at least 300 windows.
feature_formula.btc_flow_alignment: direction * BTC signed quote notional / BTC total quote notional over the completed window.
feature_formula.follower_flow_alignment: direction * follower signed quote notional / follower total quote notional over the completed window.
feature_formula.underreaction_ratio: direction * follower return / abs(beta * BTC return).

fatal_event_availability_gate.if_failed: Stop that follower before strategy PnL and do not open frozen validation.

later_trade_replay_if_gate_passes.entry: First actual follower trade at or after decision plus 100ms, provided the catch-up target was not already crossed.
state_exits: Residual catch-up to the frozen beta-implied target.
BTC impulse decay to 25 percent of decision displacement for ten consecutive valid 100ms states.
Completed opposite BTC one-second shock with prior-scaled z at least 3 and aligned aggression at least 0.5.
Adverse structural stop max(10bp, 0.75 times decision residual gap), gap-through uncapped.
